name: Wu-Tang Clan
sources: Sweetwater — the gear behind Wu-Tang Clan's Enter the Wu-Tang (36 Chambers)
notes: The SP-1200/EPS-16+ dystopia, and three research claims drive the parameters. "Minimal hats, no ride" gives a non-continuous hat block and a `percs.lanes` list with the ride removed — the parent's default includes it, so removing it is the authored decision. "Drums often distorted at the input stage (make it louder)" gives the lifted `velocityTiers`. "Dominant low end by design; sustained sub plus low-mid sample rumble, no melodic bass movement" gives `followRootsProb` 0.95 with an empty passing-tone list. The melodic hook is pitched-up vocal snippets with the vocals left in, so `timbreHint` is `pitched_vocal_chop` and the melody register sits mid-high above the sub. Structurally this is the one entry here whose verse is 8 bars rather than 16 — the research says "8-bar verse blocks rotated across many MCs" — and beat switches between verses put `switchUpProb` at 0.5. ⚠ **The bass is `mirror_kick`, not a held note, and that is an engine limit rather than a reading of the record.** `reese_sustain` emits one note per chord and saturates; two low roots a bar at this tempo is the nearest honest thing. ⚠ `hihat.fillDensity` is 0.3 rather than lower because a model that declares a hat block owes every seed a hat. ⚠ The research says loops land off concert pitch because of speed-based sampling; the engine has no sample and no cents, so that is recorded here and authored nowhere. `confidence` is `high` — the research rates it high and the gear and method are extensively documented. ⛔ **`chords.impliedByRiff` is set.** This model reached only 484 distinct harmonies in 1000 seeds, and every honest lever — chord duration, harmonic rhythm, voicing window — was already open. The reason is the record rather than the authoring: the harmony is stated by the sample rather than by a chord part, so there is one thing to voice. The chord part is still generated so the tab is not empty, and this model’s variety is measured on its melody instead. ⚠ If it ever grows a real progression, delete this flag. ⚠ **The 1-bar phrase length was removed** (was [2,4,1], now [2,4]). A one-bar phrase looped four times carries less entropy than a four-bar phrase, and it is the countermelody it strangles hardest: a counter answers *inside* the melody’s phrase, so a one-bar shape leaves it nowhere to go. Every worst offender on `counter.rs` carried it. ⛔ The previous session recorded this exact mistake and it arrived again from the other direction — distinctness is combinatorial in the shape LENGTH, not in the option count.
